title: Set Up: Roots Hold the Soil

scenes.tts: You need two matching containers, bagged topsoil, grass for one container, either sod or seed sown two to three weeks ahead, and two clear plastic cups.
scenes.narration: You need two matching containers, bagged topsoil, grass for one container, either sod or seed sown two to three weeks ahead, and two clear plastic cups.

scenes.tts: Fill both containers with the same soil, about five centimeters deep. One gets grass, from seed or sod. You cut a small notch at the low end of each. Raise the other ends on books.

items.text: Adult cuts a notch at low end
Raise the other end on books

scenes.narration: Fill both containers with the same soil, about five centimeters deep. One gets grass, from seed or sod. You cut a small notch at the low end of each. Raise the other ends on books.

scenes.tts: Pour two cups of water slowly over each tray. The cup from the bare tray is usually brown and cloudy. The cup from the grass tray is usually much clearer.
scenes.narration: Pour two cups of water slowly over each tray. The cup from the bare tray is usually brown and cloudy. The cup from the grass tray is usually much clearer.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. You do all the cutting, and you lift the wet trays, because they are heavy.

items.text: Adult does all cutting and lifting
